rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Wide prompts split by logical move — paragraph breaks = cheapest scan-affordance.

The prompt carries 3 logical moves in that one paragraph: (1) write the close-out note + link PR/branch, (2) conditional fallback 'If we needed to create the ticket just now, create it first, then update.', (3) 'Tell me what you wrote.' This exceeds the <=30-word/<=2-move short-prompt exemption, and the conditional clause matches the rule's own listed move-boundary that earns a split ('If X, do A; if Y, do B'). Its siblings close-the-ticket-1 (3 paragraphs) and close-the-ticket-2 (4 paragraphs) both correctly split their own conditional fallback into a separate paragraph; close-the-ticket-3 does not.
